title: Required fields and reconciliation rules
amount_rules: DHL sample PDFs print masked amounts (XXX,XX, X.XX, XX,XX). Store those as money.status=unknown, reason=masked_on_source_pdf.
Do not invent numeric invoice amounts for dataset_pdfs files.
Booking expected_charges are synthetic_booking_expected. They are not billed DHL amounts.
When both billed and expected amounts are known, they match only if equal to the cent (absolute difference < 0.01) in the same currency.
When billed amount is unknown, charge comparison is not_applicable. Do not treat unknown as equal to a synthetic expected charge.
shipment_id_rules: Trim whitespace; keep leading zeros; compare case-sensitively as digits/strings.
Reconciliation keys off invoice shipments[].shipment_id against booking.shipment_id.
Summarized layouts with an empty shipments array cannot complete shipment-ID match; flag for review (not an auto-continue).

reconciliation_outcomes.match: A booking exists with the same shipment_id, compared details agree, and charge comparison is either equal-to-the-cent or not_applicable because the billed amount is unknown.
reconciliation_outcomes.charge_mismatch: A booking exists with the same shipment_id, but known billed vs expected charges differ by 0.01 or more, or compared details disagree.
reconciliation_outcomes.missing_booking: An invoiced charged shipment_id has no booking record. Flag for review.
reconciliation_outcomes.not_applicable_no_shipment_ids: Invoice layout is summarized (no shipment IDs). Flag for review.
